hero.headline: We Buy Your Scrap Metal
hero.subheadline: Venezuelan company specializing in the purchase of ferrous and non-ferrous metals. Maracay, Aragua.

about.title: About Us
about.description: Comercializadora NS is a company located in the San Vicente Industrial Zone in Maracay, dedicated to the purchase and trading of recycled metals. We offer fair prices, fast service, and immediate payment.

materials.title: What We Buy
materials.subtitle: We purchase a wide variety of ferrous and non-ferrous metals.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: A simple, transparent three-step process.
howItWorks.step1Desc: Message us on WhatsApp or call us. Tell us what material you have and the approximate quantity.
howItWorks.step2Desc: We review the material, determine the price based on current market rates, and make you a fair offer.
howItWorks.step3Desc: We agree on a delivery or pickup location and payment is made immediately.

contact.title: Contact & Location
contact.subtitle: We're in Maracay, Aragua. Write to us and we'll respond right away.
contact.addressValue: Zona Industrial San Vicente, Calle Campesina, Galpón N° 36, Maracay, Aragua 2103, Venezuela

ourStory.title: Our Story
ourStory.subtitle: 30 years of family, trust, and metals
ourStory.description: Comercializadora NS was born in Maracay in the early 1990s, founded by Luis Enrique Arias Ramírez with a simple vision: fair prices, honest service, and immediate payment for those who need to sell their metals. Today, three decades later, the business remains 100% family-owned — now operated alongside his four sons. What started as a small warehouse in the San Vicente Industrial Zone has become a reference in the metal trading sector across Aragua state.
ourStory.quote: "Known for fair prices and keeping our word."

testimonials.title: What Our Clients Say
testimonials.subtitle: Businesses and individuals who trust us.

items.name: Carlos M.
items.text: I've been selling them workshop scrap for over 5 years. They always pay well and on the spot. I don't look for any other buyer.

items.name: Andreina R.
items.text: I had a pile of aluminum sitting at home. I called them, they came, weighed it, and paid on the spot. Excellent service.

items.name: José L.
items.text: They are the perfect partner for disposing of our leftover iron and steel. Market price and no hassle.
